frases.texto: After the deploy, every request came back with error four oh one, because the access token had expired.
The nightly sync hit the rate limit, and the API answered with error four twenty nine: too many requests.
We read the accounts with offset pagination, and two pages came back in a different order.
The upsert had no external ID, so the same customer was created twice, as a duplicate account.
The custom field was renamed in the CRM, and the field mapping kept sending the old name.
One system sent the date format as day, month, year, and the other read it as month, day, year.
The opportunity arrived before its parent account: a race condition between two parallel jobs.
The job reported success, but the records never arrived. It failed silently, with no error at all.
The connection timed out, and the server answered with error five oh three: service unavailable.
It worked in the sandbox, but production had a different configuration for the same variable.
